slices.behaviour: WhereTheSetRunsTest: the two callers of the set, as tests rather than as one measurement. That the hook calls the runner on the staged paths and never on the tree, that the staged mode hands each tool only those paths and runs knip in neither, that every tool goes through timed so the budget is measured on every commit, that CI runs rules --check, rules --fixtures and the tree run, and that all seven packages declare an exports map. It belongs to no single slice because the wiring spans two: the runner and the workflow steps arrived with slice 1, the hook block and the exports maps with slice 2. Four triage returns on criterion 2 were right about what they could not see, which was never the rules and always the wiring and the budget: both were proven by running them once, and a measurement taken on one afternoon is not a property the next commit keeps.
slices.failure_reason: With scripts/rules.sh absent, the workflow back at its pre-ticket version and the hook and the seven manifests back at theirs, six of the seven report a failure: three error with 'FileNotFoundError: No such file or directory: scripts/rules.sh' because there is no runner to read, and three fail with "'rules --check' not found" in the workflow, "'./scripts/rules.sh staged' not found" in the hook and "'exports' not found" in @seen/api's manifest. The seventh is the guard that the hook never runs the tree, which an absent block cannot break.
